title: Read a Number, Advance the Cursor
hints: Do not fight the double star inside the loop. Copy the caller's position into a plain local, `const char* p = *cursor;`, and do all the walking with `*p` and `++p` exactly as in problem 4.

A char is a digit when `*p >= '0' && *p <= '9'`, and its value is `*p - '0'`. Build the number with `value = value * 10 + (*p - '0');`. When the loop ends, `p` is on the first non-digit: hand that back with `*cursor = p;`. If there were no digits, `p` never moved, so writing it back changes nothing.
